crossRefs.note: He said, “Bring them here to me.”
He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to…
He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples…
He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.
He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them…
They had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.
For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
translations.bsb: “Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.
translations.kjv: And Jesus said, Make the men sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
translations.asv: Jesus said, Make the people sit down. Now there was much grass in the place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
